sounds.name: Cruel King - Block Tales OST - UnknownNamedGuy

MESSAGE: So, this is who I’ve heard so much about.
You think you're the hero of this story...
But deep down, you're as filthy as everyone else.
I’ve been… ‘tainted’… by a tormenting voice.
With the knowledge that Blackrock Kingdom will cease to exist in your future.
How do you think I feel? Withholding that knowledge from my people?
That their happiness... their home... will be gone in only a few years.
Do I give in to the prophesied future I've been told will unfold?
With the Ice Dagger… I’ll rewrite our future…
t-That voice... I-I hear it again...
